ev.q: Fatality rates were calculated for specific fisheries using estimates of the number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees
the Northeast multispecies groundfish fishery had the highest rate (600 deaths per 100,000 FTEs)
Of the total number of deaths, 261 (52%) occurred after a vessel disaster
None of the 155 workers who died as a result of falling overboard were wearing a personal flotation device (PFD).
The fisheries with the highest number of fatalities were Gulf of Mexico shrimp (55), Atlantic scallop (44), and Alaskan salmon (39)
CDC collected and analyzed data on each fatality reported during 2000--2009.

methods_quotes.q: Fatality rates were calculated for specific fisheries using estimates of the number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees
To calculate the rate, the total number of fatalities for the 10-year period was divided by the total annual FTEs for the period.
Missing data were excluded from percentage calculations.
